encoding: Each value is 32 bytes. ar is a canonical little-endian Jubjub scalar. ak and rk use canonical compressed Jubjub point encodings: the v coordinate is little-endian with the u-coordinate parity in the high bit. ar embeds unchanged into the BLS12-381 circuit scalar field.
limitation: This independent vector validates a nonzero Jubjub-scalar randomizer, a strict subset of the canonical BLS12-381 scalar range accepted by the Spend circuit. It does not constitute a complete Spend witness.
